parts.text:
**Root cause:** The `RUN cat <<'EOF' > /etc/zsh/zshrc` heredoc in `Dockerfile:149` was silently producing a 0-byte file. Docker's legacy builder passes `RUN` commands to `/bin/sh -c` as a single string argument — the heredoc body is not passed through, so `cat` had no stdin and wrote nothing.

**Fix:** Replaced the heredoc with `printf '%s\n' ... > /etc/zsh/zshrc`, consistent with how the rest of the Dockerfile already writes multi-line files.

The bira theme prompt is now correctly set:
```
╭─user@hostname ~/project (git-branch)
╰─$
```
